plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing split files (train_split.json, val_split.json), and any pre-trained models. Check what labels directories exist (labels_yolov8x_1280, labels_sc, etc.). Understand what has already been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace contents, understanding of existing configs and splits

plan.title: Explore annotation data and class distribution
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json and the existing train_split.json/val_split.json. Count images, annotations, categories. Compute per-category annotation counts, per-image annotation counts, image dimensions. Check the val split size and stratification. Examine data/metadata.json for product reference info.
plan.success_criteria: Clear statistics on dataset: num images, annotations, category distribution, image sizes, val split composition

plan.title: Explore reference product images
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory structure. Count how many products have reference images, what types (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image sizes. Cross-reference with categories in annotations.json to see coverage.
plan.success_criteria: Know how many of 357 categories have reference images, types available, and quality

plan.title: Check installed package versions and pin ultralytics
plan.description: Check current versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools. Install ultralytics==8.1.0 if not already pinned. Verify GPU availability and CUDA version. Write requirements.txt.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed, all sandbox-compatible versions verified, GPU accessible

plan.title: Create/verify 90/10 stratified split
plan.description: Check existing train_split.json and val_split.json. If they use a different split ratio (e.g., 85/15), recreate with 90/10 split stratified by store section using seed=42. Ensure all annotations for an image stay together. Target ~223 train, ~25 val images.
plan.success_criteria: train_split.json has ~223 images, val_split.json has ~25 images, proportional section representation

plan.title: Build evaluation function
plan.description: Write a reusable evaluation function in utils.py that takes predictions (COCO format list) and val_split.json ground truth, computes detection_mAP@0.5 (all categories mapped to one class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original categories), returns val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Use pycocotools COCOeval.
plan.success_criteria: Function tested and returning correct metrics on dummy data

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n with nc=357 on the training split at imgsz=640 for 100 epochs. Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format if needed (check existing labels dirs). Evaluate on val split using the evaluation function.
plan.success_criteria: Baseline val_score recorded, training completes successfully

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280px significantly outperforms YOLOv8n at 640px due to better capacity and resolution
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357 at imgsz=1280 for 300 epochs. Use existing data_multiclass.yaml if appropriate. Check if pre-existing trained weights exist in workspace. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score significantly higher than YOLOv8n baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8x single-class (nc=1) detector at 1280
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 at imgsz=1280 for 300 epochs. Use data_single_class.yaml if it exists. Compare detection_mAP@0.5 against the nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 higher than nc=357 model

plan.title: Check for existing trained models in workspace
plan.description: Search the entire workspace for .pt weight files from previous training runs. Check runs/ directory, any yolov8*.pt files. If good models already exist, skip retraining and go straight to evaluation and improvement.
plan.success_criteria: Inventory of all existing model weights with their configurations

plan.title: DINOv2-base embedding gallery construction
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images can classify detected crops better than YOLO's built-in classification for rare categories
plan.description: Build a gallery of DINOv2-base embeddings from: (1) reference product images in data/products/, (2) training annotation crops. For each category, store mean embedding. Implement kNN-based classification on detected crops from val images.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built, kNN classifier functional, classification_mAP measured

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining the best detector (nc=1) with DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections, crop each detection from full-res image, embed with DINOv2-base, classify via kNN against gallery. Compute full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score higher than best single YOLO model

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO classification when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain yields better classification than either alone
plan.description: For each detection from nc=357 YOLO, if class confidence > threshold use YOLO's class, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep confidence threshold on val split. Also try: always use DINOv2, always use YOLO, and the gated approach.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal gating threshold, val_score improvement over single method

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold (0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8) and confidence threshold (0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3) on val split using best detector. Record detection_mAP and val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/conf thresholds identified, val_score improvement quantified

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA (multi-scale + flip) improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP and val_score with and without TTA. Measure inference time to ensure it fits within 300s budget.
plan.success_criteria: TTA val_score improvement measured, inference time acceptable

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images catches small products missed by single-pass inference, improving detection mAP significantly
plan.description: Implement SAHI-style sliced inference: split each image into overlapping 1280×1280 tiles (stride ~960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Test on val split. Measure detection_mAP improvement and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement > 2 points, inference time within budget

plan.title: kNN hyperparameter tuning for DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Tuning k, temperature, and distance weighting improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Sweep k (1, 3, 5, 7, 11), temperature (0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5), and distance metric (cosine, L2) for kNN classification on val split crops. Also test majority voting vs distance-weighted voting.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal kNN parameters found, classification_mAP improvement measured

plan.title: Gallery composition optimization
plan.hypothesis: Different weightings of reference images vs training crops in the gallery affect classification quality
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (1) reference images only, (2) training crops only, (3) both with equal weight, (4) reference images repeated 3x + training crops 1x, (5) reference images 1x + training crops 2x. Measure classification_mAP for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training and evaluation
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l provides different error patterns than YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l (available in ultralytics 8.1.0) with nc=357 at imgsz=1280 for 300 epochs. Evaluate standalone val_score. Compare detection patterns with YOLOv8x.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score recorded, error pattern analysis completed

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLOv8x + RT-DETR-l
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling architecturally diverse models improves detection mAP by 2-4 points
plan.description: Combine predictions from YOLOv8x and RT-DETR-l using Weighted Boxes Fusion. Sweep WBF IoU threshold and model weights. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score > best single model val_score

plan.title: YOLOv8x model size comparison: l vs x
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x provides meaningful improvement over YOLOv8l to justify its larger size
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l at imgsz=1280 for 300 epochs. Compare val_score, model size, and inference time against YOLOv8x. Determine if the size/speed tradeoff is worth it.
plan.success_criteria: Clear comparison of l vs x on val_score, size, and speed

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Build gallery with DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14). Compare classification_mAP against DINOv2-base on same val detections. Measure model size and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison, size/time tradeoff quantified

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A small MLP trained with ArcFace/SupCon loss on DINOv2 features improves product discrimination
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train a 2-layer MLP projection head using contrastive loss (ArcFace or SupCon) on training crops + reference images. Use the projected embeddings for kNN classification. Compare classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: Multi-crop inference for DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations reduces sensitivity to exact box boundaries
plan.description: For each detection, extract 3-4 crop variations (original, center-zoomed 80%, padded 120%, slight shift). Average their DINOv2 embeddings before kNN lookup. Compare classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement measured

plan.title: Training at higher resolution: 1600 or 1920
plan.hypothesis: Training at higher resolution preserves more product detail and improves detection of small items
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x (or YOLOv8l for speed) at imgsz=1600 with reduced batch size and gradient accumulation. Compare val_score against 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison, determine if higher res training is worth the cost

plan.title: Longer training: 500-800 epochs with patience
plan.hypothesis: 357 categories need more epochs to converge, especially rare classes
plan.description: Train best YOLO config for 500-800 epochs with patience=150. Monitor val_score convergence curve. Compare against 300-epoch model.
plan.success_criteria: Determine optimal epoch count, val_score improvement if any

plan.title: Close mosaic timing optimization
plan.hypothesis: Longer clean-image fine-tuning at end of training improves final precision
plan.description: Train with close_mosaic=100 and close_mosaic=150 (vs default 50). Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal close_mosaic value identified

plan.title: Label smoothing for nc=357 training
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with label_smoothing=0.1 and 0.05. Compare val_score against no smoothing.
plan.success_criteria: Best label_smoothing value identified

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Pasting reference product images onto shelf backgrounds as synthetic augmentation helps rare categories
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: extract reference product images, apply perspective warps and lighting adjustments, paste onto training shelf images. Retrain with augmented data. Focus on categories with <5 training examples.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, especially classification_mAP for rare categories

plan.title: nc=1 detector with tiled inference + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining tiled inference (best detection) with DINOv2 (best classification) maximizes val_score
plan.description: Run nc=1 YOLO with SAHI tiling on val images, classify all crops with best DINOv2 setup. This combines the best detection and classification approaches found so far.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score achieved so far

plan.title: WBF ensemble: multiple scales of same model
plan.hypothesis: Running the same model at multiple scales and fusing catches products at different sizes
plan.description: Run YOLOv8x at 640, 1280, and 1920 (or tiled), fuse with WBF. Compare detection_mAP against single-scale.
plan.success_criteria: Multi-scale ensemble improves detection_mAP

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section are correlated; using co-occurrence priors improves classification
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data (which categories appear in same image/section). Apply as Bayesian prior on DINOv2 classification probabilities. Test on val split.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement from co-occurrence priors

plan.title: Per-category adaptive confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Different categories need different confidence thresholds for optimal classification
plan.description: For each category, find optimal confidence threshold on val split. Categories with unique appearance get low thresholds (easy to classify), similar-looking categories get high thresholds (fall back to category_id=0 when uncertain).
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens is more robust to occlusion than global embedding
plan.description: Instead of using CLS token or mean pooling, extract patch-level tokens from DINOv2. Match query crop patches against gallery patches using optimal transport or simple cosine similarity. Compare classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison against global embedding approach

plan.title: ONNX export and inference time benchmarking
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is faster than PyTorch, allowing more room for tiling/ensemble
plan.description: Export best YOLO model and DINOv2 to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference time on val split. Compare against PyTorch inference. Check total weight file sizes against 420MB limit.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX models exported, inference time and size within constraints

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization reduces model size by ~50% with minimal accuracy loss
plan.description: Quantize best YOLO model to INT8. Compare val_score, model size, and inference time against FP16. Determine if the accuracy tradeoff is acceptable.
plan.success_criteria: INT8 model size < 70MB, val_score drop < 0.5 points

plan.title: Full ensemble: best detector(s) + tiling + DINOv2 + co-occurrence
plan.hypothesis: Combining all best techniques achieves the highest possible val_score
plan.description: Assemble the full pipeline: best detector(s) with tiling, WBF fusion, DINOv2 classification with fine-tuned projection head, co-occurrence priors, adaptive thresholds. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score achieved

plan.title: Build submission run.py
plan.description: Write run.py that implements the best pipeline found. Ensure it uses only sandbox-allowed imports (pathlib not os, json not yaml, no blocked modules). Test with simulated sandbox constraints.
plan.success_criteria: run.py runs correctly, produces valid predictions.json, uses only allowed imports

plan.title: End-to-end submission test
plan.hypothesis: The submission pipeline runs within 300s on simulated L4 constraints
plan.description: Run the full submission pipeline on val images, timing each component. Verify total time < 300s (accounting for L4 being slower than A800). Verify output format matches COCO predictions format. Verify total weight size < 420MB.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline completes in <300s estimated L4 time, correct output format, weights <420MB

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test-time detections to the DINOv2 gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: First pass: run detector + classifier on all test images. Second pass: add crops with score>0.85 to gallery, re-classify uncertain detections. Products appearing multiple times get better gallery coverage.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement from pseudo-labeling

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE and white balance
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detection on poorly lit shelf images
plan.description: Apply CLAHE and/or white balance correction to val images before detection. Compare detection_mAP with and without preprocessing.
plan.success_criteria: Determine if preprocessing helps, measure val_score impact

plan.title: Rectangular inference mode
plan.hypothesis: rect=True preserves aspect ratio better than square resize, improving detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run inference with rect=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP against square inference.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison recorded

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / focal loss for rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling rare categories or using focal loss improves classification of rare products
plan.description: Retrain with class-balanced sampling (oversample images containing rare categories) or increased focal loss gamma. Compare classification_mAP for rare vs common categories.
plan.success_criteria: Improved classification_mAP for rare categories without hurting common ones

plan.title: Progressive resizing training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 first then switching to 1280 is faster and may generalize better
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at 640 for 100 epochs, then resume at 1280 for 200 epochs. Compare val_score and total training time against training at 1280 for 300 epochs.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison, training time comparison

plan.title: Embedding-weighted WBF fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal in WBF improves fusion quality
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from different models in WBF, weight by both detection confidence and DINOv2 embedding agreement between the crops. If two models produce similar embeddings for overlapping boxes, boost confidence.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and packaging
plan.description: Optimize the final pipeline for speed: batch DINOv2 inference, minimize I/O, use efficient data structures. Package all weights and code into submission.zip. Final verification of all constraints.
plan.success_criteria: Submission zip < 420MB, run.py works end-to-end, all constraints met

plan.title: Ablation study: contribution of each component
plan.hypothesis: Understanding which components contribute most helps prioritize for final submission
plan.description: Systematically disable each component (tiling, TTA, DINOv2, co-occurrence, ensemble) and measure val_score drop. Identify which components are essential vs marginal.
plan.success_criteria: Clear ranking of component contributions to val_score

plan.title: Sensitivity analysis on val split
plan.hypothesis: Results are stable across different random seeds for the val split
plan.description: Run best pipeline on 3 different val splits (seeds 42, 123, 456). Check if val_score is consistent. If not, consider using cross-validation for more robust estimates.
plan.success_criteria: val_score variance < 2 points across splits

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs standard NMS for dense shelves
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS preserves more overlapping detections on dense shelves than hard NMS
plan.description: Replace standard NMS with Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay) in the inference pipeline. Sweep sigma parameter. Compare detection_mAP on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Determine if Soft-NMS improves detection_mAP on dense shelf images

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting manually verified annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Check annotations for 'corrected' field. Duplicate or upweight corrected annotations in training. Retrain and compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from annotation weighting

plan.title: Smaller YOLO + more tiles tradeoff
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with more overlapping tiles may outperform YOLOv8x with fewer tiles due to better effective resolution
plan.description: Compare: YOLOv8x with 4 tiles vs YOLOv8m with 9 tiles (more overlap, smaller stride). Measure detection_mAP and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Determine optimal model-size vs tile-count tradeoff

plan.title: Two YOLO models in ensemble: nc=1 + nc=357
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 model has better recall, nc=357 has class info; combining them is better than either alone
plan.description: Run both nc=1 and nc=357 YOLO models. Use nc=1 boxes (better recall) with nc=357 class predictions where boxes overlap. For nc=1-only boxes, use DINOv2 classification. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over single model approaches

plan.title: DINOv2 with register tokens (DINOv2-reg)
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 with register tokens produces cleaner embeddings for classification
plan.description: If available in timm 0.9.12, use DINOv2 with register tokens variant. Compare embedding quality and classification_mAP against standard DINOv2.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP comparison recorded

plan.title: Spatial context features for classification
plan.hypothesis: Adding spatial context (shelf position, neighboring products) improves classification
plan.description: For each detection, encode its relative position in the image (x, y, width, height normalized) and concatenate with DINOv2 embedding. Train a small classifier that uses both visual and spatial features.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement from spatial features

plan.title: Score calibration for optimal mAP
plan.hypothesis: Calibrating detection scores improves mAP by better ranking predictions
plan.description: Apply Platt scaling or isotonic regression to calibrate detection scores on val split. Check if calibrated scores improve mAP computation.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with and without calibration

plan.title: Max detections per image tuning
plan.hypothesis: Default max_det may be too low for images with ~91 annotations average
plan.description: Sweep max_det parameter (100, 200, 300, 500) in YOLO inference. Some images may have 150+ products. Ensure we're not losing detections due to the limit.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal max_det found, no detections lost due to limit

plan.title: Augmentation ablation for training
plan.hypothesis: Some augmentations help dense shelf detection while others hurt
plan.description: Train with different augmentation configs: disable mosaic, disable mixup, adjust scale/translate ranges, test with/without HSV augmentation. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal augmentation config identified

plan.title: Document best configuration
plan.description: Write a comprehensive summary of the best configuration found: model architecture, training hyperparameters, inference pipeline (tiling, NMS, classification method), val_score breakdown (detection_mAP, classification_mAP). Include all settings needed for the human to retrain on full data.
plan.success_criteria: Complete configuration document that enables full-data retraining

plan.title: Final val_score verification
plan.hypothesis: The complete pipeline achieves the reported val_score consistently
plan.description: Run the complete best pipeline end-to-end on val split 3 times. Verify consistent val_score. Check for any randomness in the pipeline (NMS ties, etc.).
plan.success_criteria: Consistent val_score across runs, final number confirmed

plan.title: Final submission packaging and constraint verification
plan.description: Final check: run.py uses only allowed imports, no blocked modules, weights < 420MB total (max 3 files), ONNX opset ≤ 20 if using ONNX, no .bin files. Create final submission.zip. Simulate sandbox execution.
plan.success_criteria: Submission passes all constraint checks, ready for human to submit
